t: The Menorah has a directional facing is designed to emulate the lighting of the Shamash, followed by each subsequent candle, going from right to left.$(br2).
多连灯烛台具有方向朝向，其设计意在模拟沙玛什（Shamash）蜡烛的点燃顺序，随后依次点燃其余每支蜡烛，从右至左排列。$(br2)

To light the Menorah, you will need the following: $(li)1 Blue Candle $(li) 8 White Candles $(li)Flint and Steel $(br2)The candles go into the Menorah as follows: Blue first, then the remaining White Candles.
点燃多连灯烛台需准备以下物品：$(li)1支蓝色蜡烛 $(li)8支白色蜡烛 $(li)打火石 $(br2)蜡烛置入多连灯烛台的顺序为：先蓝后白。

Begin by placing the Shamash, the Blue Candle, and then light it. Then place the second, and light it. Repeat this process until all candles are lit.$(br2)The more candles that are lit, the more light the Menorah will give off.
首先放置沙玛什（即蓝色蜡烛）并点燃；随后放置第二支并点燃；依此类推，直至全部蜡烛点亮。$(br2)点亮的蜡烛越多，多连灯烛台散发的光亮越强。

If you use the wrong color candle, it will give the most recently placed candle back to you and you can try again.$(br2)If your Menorah does not light up, remove all of the candles (just click with an empty hand) and place them/light them again in the proper order.
若误用错误颜色的蜡烛，系统将返还你最新放置的那支蜡烛，供你重试。$(br2)若多连灯烛台未能点亮，请先全部移除蜡烛（空手点击即可），再按正确顺序重新放置并点燃。
